title: Past days become episodes, old days roll up into a week, and a detail from weeks ago is still recalled

turns.user: My sister Mina and I finally cleared out grandma's apartment today. Exhausting and a bit sad. We found her old handwritten recipe notebook in the kitchen drawer.
Started a pottery class tonight. The teacher, Leila, says I center the clay too fast.
Busy week. I'm presenting the quarterly numbers on Thursday.
What was that thing Mina and I found when we cleared out grandma's place?
